_meta.indication: Treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease (DED)

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in reviewed FDA documents
pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, multi-center, randomized, double-masked, saline-controlled study; subjects received NOV03 QID or saline (0.6% sodium chloride) QID over a 10-week period
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with dry eye disease (DED) associated with meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: change from baseline in total corneal fluorescein staining (tCFS) at Day 57 and change from baseline in the eye dryness VAS score at Day 57
pivotal_trials.result: tCFS Day 57: LS mean difference NOV03 – saline -1.0 (95% CI -1.4, -0.6), p<0.001; eye dryness VAS Day 57: -7.6 (95% CI -11.8, -3.4), p<0.001

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in reviewed FDA documents
pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3, multi-center, randomized, double-masked, saline-controlled study; design same as NVU-003 (NOV03 QID vs saline QID)
pivotal_trials.population: Subjects with dry eye disease (DED) associated with meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: change from baseline in tCFS at Day 57 and change from baseline in the eye dryness VAS score at Day 57 (same as NVU-003)
pivotal_trials.n: N=620 randomized and treated; No. randomized 311 (NOV03) and 309 (saline)
pivotal_trials.result: tCFS Day 57: LS mean difference NOV03 – saline -1.21 (95% CI -1.66, -0.76), p<0.001; eye dryness VAS Day 57: -10.2 (95% CI -14.3, -6.1), p<0.001

key_safety: Most common ocular adverse reaction was blurred vision; blurred vision and conjunctival redness were reported in 1-3% of individuals
target_moa: Perfluorohexyloctane, a semifluorinated alkane, forms a monolayer at the air-liquid interface of the tear film which can be expected to reduce evaporation; the exact mechanism of action in DED is not known
modality: Small molecule (semifluorinated alkane); ophthalmic solution containing 100% perfluorohexyloctane

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held for the NDA; there were no issues felt to benefit from discussion

summary.text: NDA 216675 was submitted under section 505(b) and reviewed as a standard (non-priority) application; it was approved within the first cycle based on two Phase 3 saline-controlled trials (NVU-003 and BL-904) without accelerated approval, breakthrough, fast track, or orphan designation.

citations.quote: submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Miebo (perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution). This NDA provides for the use of Miebo (perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution) for treatment of the signs and symptoms of Dry Eye Disease (DED).

The adequate and well controlled studies (NVU-003 and BL-904) contained in this submission establish the efficacy of Miebo (perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution) dosed 4 times a day for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease.

requirement.text: 4447-1: Conduct a randomized, controlled trial to evaluate corneal endothelial health of eyes treated with perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution by monitoring corneal endothelial cell number/density using specular microscopy at baseline and over at least one year in at least 100 patients

citations.quote: 4447-1 Conduct a randomized, controlled trial to evaluate the corneal endothelial health of eyes treated with perfluorohexylcetane ophthalmic solution by monitoring the number/density of corneal endothelial cells using specular microscopy at baseline and over a period of at least one year in at least 100 patients receiving perfluorohexylcetane ophthalmic solution.
